tracks.title: Cuốn Sổ Ba Mươi Mốt Tên
tracks.subject: Bà Sáu, godmother to thirty-one children of her Biên Hòa parish, has never missed one godchild's birthday, each logged in a school notebook; on her own eightieth birthday, an ordinary Sunday after mass, she has forgotten it, and all thirty-one godchildren are waiting at the church gate with a brass band and presents.
